SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_RESUME_M r JOIN TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a ON r.resume_sq = a.resume_sq JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M p ON a.project_sq = p.project_sq JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON p.company_sq = c.company_sq WHERE r.user_sq = #{userSq}
AND p.project_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND c.company_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (p.project_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.company_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.read_application_dtm IS NOT NULL AND a.read_application_dtm IS NULL

SELECT 'all' AS type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON r.resume_sq = a.resume_sq WHERE r.user_sq = #{userSq} UNION ALL SELECT 'read' AS type, COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON r.resume_sq = a.resume_sq WHERE r.user_sq = #{userSq} AND a.read_application_dtm IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'unread' AS type, COUNT(*) FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON r.resume_sq = a.resume_sq WHERE r.user_sq = #{userSq} AND a.read_application_dtm IS NULL
SELECT project_sq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_application_sq = #{appSq}
SELECT project_application_sq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_sq = #{projectSq} and company_sq = #{companySq}
SELECT resume_sq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_application_sq = #{appSq}
SELECT company_sq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_application_sq = #{appSq}
SELECT project_application_sq FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_sq = #{projectSq}

SELECT read_application_dtm AS readResumeDt, project_application_created_at_dtm AS appDt, selected_interview_dtm AS interviewDt, CASE project_application_status_cd WHEN 801 THEN '지원중' WHEN 802 THEN '불합격' WHEN 803 THEN '합격' WHEN 804 THEN '인터뷰요청중' WHEN 805 THEN '인터뷰확정' WHEN 806 THEN '지원취소' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS appStatus FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H WHERE project_application_sq = #{appSq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PROJECT_INTERVIEW_TIME_SLOT_S SET interview_is_selected_yn = 'Y' WHERE interview_sq = #{interviewSq}
mapper.select: SELECT a.project_application_sq AS applicationSq, r.resume_sq AS resumeSq, r.resume_nm AS resumeNm, r.resume_ttl AS resumeTtl, c.company_nm AS companyNm, a.project_application_status_cd AS statusCd, a.project_application_member_type_cd AS memberTypeCd, a.project_application_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, CASE a.project_application_status_cd WHEN 801 THEN '지원중' WHEN 802 THEN '불합격' WHEN 803 THEN '합격' WHEN 804 THEN '인터뷰요청중' WHEN 805 THEN '인터뷰확정' WHEN 806 THEN '지원취소' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS appStatus, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT st.skill_tag_nm) AS skillNames FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON a.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON a.resume_sq = r.resume_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_RESUME_PROJECT_HISTORY_S ph ON r.resume_sq = ph.resume_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_RESUME_PROJECT_HISTORY_SKILL_TAG_S rst ON ph.project_history_sq = rst.project_history_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C st ON rst.skill_tag_sq = st.skill_tag_sq WHERE a.project_sq = #{projectSq} AND COALESCE(a.company_sq, -1) IN #{item} AND a.project_application_status_cd = #{status} GROUP BY a.project_application_sq, r.resume_sq, r.resume_nm, r.resume_ttl, c.company_nm, a.project_application_status_cd, a.project_application_member_type_cd, a.project_application_created_at_dtm ORDER BY a.company_sq, a.project_application_created_at_dtm DESC
